dev_notes: readout() in src/diff.mjs, printed by cmdPreview in src/commands/build.mjs. Code churn is linesSince(): `git diff --numstat <previous release commit>` against the working tree plus untracked files, leaving out the ledger and the documents it prints. Nothing maps code to entries, and nothing remembers the last look.

history.name: The size of the open release
history.description: The command ledger preview opens with the size of the open release: its new, updated and removed entries by size, the changes recorded and not yet prepared, and the lines of code changed since the last edition. It costs nothing to run.
history.how_to_see: Run ledger preview: before it prints the draft, it shows the new, updated and removed entries by size, the changes recorded, and the lines of code changed since the last edition.
